text:
incidents-bot: PAGER: oncall-sre — Automated metric alert: sudden 5xx/timeouts for hosted API (/v1/generate) starting 2026-03-15T10:03:00Z. Error-rate ~18%, p95 latency elevated. Potential KV/prefix cache correlation (kv_prefix_miss_rate increased).

pagerduty: page sent to oncall-sre. root cause unknown — investigating.

oncall-sre: on it. looking at dashboards now. linking grafana: https://grafana.redwood/app/d/kv-metrics

maria (eng-runtime): i'm seeing eviction_rate spike on prefix-cache shards shard-12..shard-17 around 10:02. cache size dip then rebuilds. possible aggressive GC/eviction cycle.

sam (eng-platform): any deploy at 10:00? I see a config push to cache-autotuner at 09:58 (change: "eviction_multiplier" from 1.0 -> 0.5). rolling back now.

ev an (eng-ml): typo in name — evan: also correlating request seq length distribution change from a customer A churned job hitting long seq (2000+), causing KV hot prefixes.

lisa (support): we have inbound support tickets mentioning 502s from customers in US-East. high-priority acct acme-inc reported timeouts.

oncall-sre: mitigation plan: 1) stop cache-autotuner rollouts 2) increase cache TTL on affected shards, 3) enable DB fallback on gateway for prefix misses, 4) clear small set of suspect shards with coordinated handoff. executing steps 1+3 now.

maria (eng-runtime): rolling back config: `kubectl set image deploy/cache-autotuner cache-autotuner=cache-autotuner:stable` — applying to prod clusters. also temporarily disabling prefetcher (`PREFETCH_ENABLED=false`).

sam (eng-platform): applied rollback in us-east-1 and us-west-2. prefet ch disabled in us-east only (canary). monitoring.

oncall-sre: enabling graceful DB fallback on gateway route for /v1/generate to reduce 5xx: added header `x-fallback-db: true` for requests with prefix-cache miss.

ev an (eng-ml): running targeted prefix-scan to detect corruption: `python tools/kv_check.py --shard 12-17 --mode quick` — results show increased null-reads but no checksum mismatch yet. suspect eviction storm rather than disk corruption.

maria (eng-runtime): to reduce eviction pressure, increasing LRU window: `curl -XPOST https://cache-admin.internal/scale -d '{"lru_window": 12}'` — applied to shard group. watching eviction_rate.

oncall-sre: traffic impact reduced to ~6% 5xx after the rollback + DB fallback. still seeing intermittent gateway timeouts from overloaded cache workers.

sam (eng-platform): plan B if still flapping: restart cache pods with `kubectl rollout restart deploy/cache-worker -n prod` one shard at a time to avoid thundering herd. ready to execute on approval.

lisa (support): heads-up to CS: Jordan, Acme Inc asking for ETA, they see 502s since 10:05.

jordan (customer-success): telling Acme: we're investigating, mitigation in progress, partial fallback enabled. will update in 15m.

oncall-sre: approve restart plan. doing staggered restarts starting shard-12 -> wait 30s -> shard-13... will monitor health and redisplay.

incidents-bot: deploy-bot: restarting deployment cache-worker prod/shard-12 by user oncall-sre at 10:20Z.

maria (eng-runtime): restart done for shard-12. metrics: worker CPU down, error-rate for that shard dropped to baseline. continuing restarts.

oncall-sre: after restarts and rollback, overall 5xx back to ~1.5%, p95 latency back to normal in ~12m. marking incident as mitigated but keeping thread open for handoff and postmortem.

ev an (eng-ml): note: prefetcher bug + eviction multiplier change created a feedback loop with unusually long sequences from customer jobs. recommend locking autotuner change until we have simulated load test.

sam (eng-platform): creating a hotfix PR to add canary gating for autotuner changes and rollback automation.

lisa (support): collecting affected customers list: Acme Inc, BrightCo, two sandbox orgs. compile emails for triage.

oncall-sre: handoff to next oncall @ 12:00Z — summary: root cause likely mis-tuned eviction_multiplier + prefetch interactions causing eviction storms and cache missstorm -> increased DB fallbacks -> gateway timeouts. Mitigations performed: rollback config, disabled prefetcher (canary), enabled DB fallback, staggered cache-worker restarts, increased lru window. Impact: transient 5xx spike ~18% -> mitigated to baseline.

jordan (customer-success): will follow up with customers and schedule RFC for autotuner changes.

maria (eng-runtime): follow-ups: run replay test with long-sequence workload, add more observability on prefix miss origins, implement safeguard to block autotuner changes without load sim.

oncall-sre: filing incident ticket and assigning postmortem owners: eng-runtime (maria) + eng-platform (sam) + support (lisa). target postmortem draft in 48h.

incidents-bot: incident_status: mitigated -> monitoring.

end of thread.
